summary: BIONIC™ Behavior Suite (P0-1) Backend Testing Complete - All 8 endpoints and 6 engines verified. 30/30 pytest tests passed. All engines use heuristic/stub logic (no real ML) as expected for P0-1 foundations.
passed_tests: ✅ GET /api/bionic/behavior/status - Returns operational status with 6 active engines
✅ GET /api/bionic/behavior/analyze - Behavior analysis for deer with activity scores, windows, recommendations
✅ GET /api/bionic/behavior/analyze - With weather parameters (temperature, precipitation, wind, moon_phase)
✅ GET /api/bionic/behavior/seasonal - Seasonal attractiveness for moose with phase, hotspots, trends
✅ GET /api/bionic/behavior/activity - Activity probability with hourly probabilities and optimal window
✅ GET /api/bionic/behavior/rut - Rut prediction for deer at 47°N with timeline, behaviors, tactics
✅ GET /api/bionic/behavior/movement - Movement analysis with corridors, home range, bedding/feeding areas
✅ GET /api/bionic/behavior/species-model - Species model for bear with profile, habitat, tips, gear
✅ GET /api/bionic/behavior/full - Full analysis with all 6 engines in parallel
✅ GET /api/bionic/behavior/full - Selective engine execution (behavior + seasonal only)
✅ All 8 Quebec species supported: moose, deer, bear, caribou, wolf, turkey, waterfowl, smallgame
✅ Input validation: Missing required params returns 422
✅ Input validation: Invalid species code returns 422
✅ Edge case: Extreme north Quebec (55°N) handled correctly
✅ Edge case: Southern Quebec (45°N) handled correctly
✅ Edge case: Moon phase boundaries (0 and 1) handled correctly
critical_code_review_comments: All 6 engines properly implemented with consistent response structure
Pydantic models well-defined for input/output validation
Parallel execution in /full endpoint working correctly
Good French localization for species names and phase descriptions
Circadian profiles and seasonal phases properly modeled for Quebec species
Rut prediction correctly uses latitude for timing calculations
seed_data_creation: None - all engines use heuristic/stub logic with calibrated data for Quebec species
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0-1 Behavior Suite implementation complete. All 6 engines (BehaviorEngine, SeasonalAttractivenessEngine, ActivityProbabilityEngine, RutPredictionEngine, MovementEngine, SpeciesModelEngine) are operational with heuristic logic. The /full endpoint combines all engines in parallel. Data is modeled/simulated based on Quebec species profiles, circadian patterns, and seasonal phases. No real ML models - this is foundation phase.

mocked_apis.note: All engines use heuristic/stub logic with calibrated data. No external API calls. This is expected for P0-1 foundations - real ML models planned for P0-2.
